Source: https://github.com/AnatolyGeorgievski/gostsum

License: GNU GPL version 3 or later — see LICENSE.

Mirrored subset for GOST hashes + digest glue:
  gosthash.c, stribog.c, hmac.c, hmac.h, Makefile, README.md

The full gostsum binary also needs r3_args.c/h, gostsum.c, and other digest sources.
This folder is a reference snapshot, not a guaranteed standalone build.

Snapshot date: 2026-05-11.
